name: default

shaders_example._doc: R4/S3 smoke test (wet floor via Mode 3 hooks — supersedes the S1 wet-world.frag full-shader demo). Rename this key to `shaders` and run `bun run build-packs` to enable. Default ships disabled.

_materialsSmokeTest_doc: M1+M2+M3 of MATERIALS.md smoke test. Flip `materialsSmokeTest` to `true` and run `bun run build-packs` to see ALL THREE tiers light up: (M1) alternate ammo pickups get a per-entity Shader pointing at shaders/ghost-sprite.glsl (translucent green wave); (M2) cells assigned the wet.floor preset in scene_heights_demo render with 85% mirror reflectivity via shaders/wet-cell.glsl; (M3) scene2.json declares shaders.worldHooks=shaders/scene-fog.glsl which adds a hot-orange depth-attenuated tint via hook_modifyFinalColor. Disabled by default — with this flag off the engine compiles its pack-default programs and rendering is byte-identical to pre-MATERIALS today, even though the wet.floor preset and scene2.json shaders block are still in the pack (they're inert until the flag flips).
